paragraphs: The X2 M35i has been a mainstay of the X2 diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early F39 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the F39 and later the F39, the X2 M35i switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X2 M35i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
